The Node 24 integration run was stopped at 14:32 UTC when the check script hit its 90-minute background time limit, as expected. Vitest never printed its final summary, so `pnpm test:integration` (acceptance item 3) is still not completed. I did not restart it, because I'm past the time limit for this assignment.

When it stopped, 198 test files had passed and 2 had failures, out of 378. The failed tests are the same 3 already described in the handback:
- **Assistant rate-limit log test:** fails every time, including when run alone; it belongs to the assistant work, not this task.
- **Two contract-test failures:** both passed when that file was run alone (110/110).

The stop also cancelled the script's last step, the DG5 historical validator. That doesn't leave a gap: I had already run the validator on its own on Node 24, and it passed (exit 0).

I added the final counts to `docs/delivery/handbacks/DG6/T-DG6-DO-FB-evidence/node24/test-integration-snapshot.txt`. The handback still quotes the 14:24 snapshot (161 passed + 2 with failures), and its conclusions are unchanged. What remains is one full integration run on a less loaded host, after the assistant test is fixed by its owner.
